commonCategory: Functions relating to networking (host names, IP addresses, etc.) or making remote calls.
commonDescription:
Sends an HTTP _POST_ request and returns a `stroom-http` XML response containing the status, headers
and body. The request body is optional.
commonReturnDescription: An XML response document containing the response or an error.
name: http-call

args.description: Optional newline-separated HTTP headers in `name:value` form.
args.name: headers

args.description: The request media type; defaults to `application/json; charset=utf-8`.
args.name: mediaType

args.description: Optional JSON HTTP client configuration, including SSL settings.
args.name: clientConfig
